interface.longDescription: Han's Codex skill collection. Ships han-skill-creator-plus (self-learning skill factory), han-imagen (image generation engine, OpenAI/Google), han-infographic / han-hand-write-pic / han-disassembly-diagram (infographic, sketchnote, teardown with anti-hallucination two-phase flow + self-learning), han-slides (image slide deck → PPTX/PDF), and han-llm-wiki (personal knowledge-base wiki with 9 commands: init/ingest/query/lint/card/weekly/research/mode/think/save). Includes han-kernel-crash-analyzer (Linux kernel crash analysis — NULL pointer / KASAN UAF / SLUB / deadlock — with disassembly-first workflow + self-learning). Also ships han-d2-diagram (D2 declarative diagrams), han-git-commit (interactive git commit message generator), and han-flash-test (UFS/eMMC read/write benchmark). Also ships han-util-tools (kernel dev toolkit router — /han-util-tools command routes Debug/Bringup/Feature-dev scenarios to sub-skills via scenario→platform→module→type; new sub-skills created on demand via han-skill-creator-plus). Also ships han-tech-doc-writer (technical documentation writer with D2 diagrams + han-infographic infographics, 7-step workflow: diagnose→source→outline→diagrams+infographics→write→review→output, self-learning feedback loop). Also ships qualcomm-reboot-analyzer (Qualcomm/Android reboot-behavior root cause analysis without dumps — RescueParty escalation audit, ABL/misc-BCB recovery-entry diagnosis, power-cycle stress failure triage, death-fingerprint evidence + self-learning). Also ships qualcomm-flash-validation-analyzer (Qualcomm QMVS flash-validation test-failure root cause analysis — 45-item result CSV alignment, driver-tree check (msm/common dual-tree trap), governor three-branch analysis, device experiment matrix (load profiling / forced clock-scale bisection / no-suspend control / ftrace load series), layered root cause + fix patches (downdifferential split / quirk entry), self-learning). Also ships qualcomm-current-consumption (Qualcomm/Android standby current-consumption root cause analysis — sleep-level triage via aosd/cxsd/ddr, AOP dump/hansei parsing, UFS spm_lvl, GPIO/NFC always-on pins, STM/QDSS blocking deep sleep, layered conclusions via qcom_sleep_stats, symptom→level→cause self-learning).
